PAPERS.title: Feasibility of an inexpensive single-particle SIBS instrument
PAPERS.n: Metadata only - no abstract in Crossref, Europe PMC or the publisher page on the entry date. Title asserts a feasibility study for a low-cost single-particle SIBS instrument; no performance figure can be quoted until the abstract deposits

PAPERS.title: Enhanced three-dimensional light scattering sensor (3D-LSS) for online characterization of aerosol particle shape: Development and validation with test aerosols
PAPERS.pm: Angularly resolved elastic scattering, single particle
PAPERS.n: Metadata only - no abstract retrievable on the entry date. Title states development plus validation against test aerosols of an enhanced 3D light-scattering sensor for online particle shape; the validation aerosols and size range are not recoverable yet

PAPERS.title: Monitoring and estimating PM2.5 and PM10 concentrations in Western Sub-Saharan Africa: Challenges and perspectives
PAPERS.pm: Regional PM2.5/PM10 monitoring and estimation capacity
PAPERS.n: Metadata only - no abstract retrievable on the entry date. Scope is the monitoring and estimation of PM2.5/PM10 across Western Sub-Saharan Africa, the sparsest reference network on the continent and the canonical low-cost-sensor use case

PAPERS.title: Effects of V2O5, NiO, and Fe2O3 surface coatings on the optical properties of black carbon aggregates
PAPERS.pm: Optical properties of coated BC aggregates
PAPERS.n: Metadata only - no abstract retrievable on the entry date. Metal-oxide coatings on BC aggregates bear directly on absorption-based BC measurement, where the coating enhancement factor is the dominant systematic in aethalometer and photoacoustic retrievals

PAPERS.title: PPDRTL: A novel framework for predicting pollutant deposition on roadside tree leaves using linear regression
PAPERS.pm: AQI regressed on leaf-surface image texture features
PAPERS.n: 10-day pilot at high/medium/low-traffic roadside sites, Haryana; PSO/DPSO/FODPSO segmentation of leaf images, contrast-entropy-SD features, linear regression to HSPCB reference AQI; FODPSO variant R2 up to 0.894, RMSE 8.76-12.34 ug m-3

PAPERS.title: Modelling monthly Boundary Layer Height maps combining radiosonde, satellite, and reanalysis over Europe
PAPERS.pm: Gridded monthly PBL height, 25 km, 00 and 12 UTC
PAPERS.n: 2010-2020, radiosonde plus land-surface-temperature and topographic covariates plus ERA5; random forest regression kriging beat linear and gradient boosting. Midday winter spatial RMSE <=170 m vs >=250 m for ERA5; night performance degrades sharply

PAPERS.title: Assimilation of SO2 TROPOMI Retrievals at the European Scale with EAKF Implemented in MINNI Through DART
PAPERS.pm: TROPOMI SO2-COBRA total column into MINNI CTM
PAPERS.n: August 2023, continental Europe, 20-member ensemble with perturbed emissions and boundary conditions; domain-mean column correction 2e-5 mol m-2, local maxima 3.3e-4; surface corrections up to 2.6 ug m-3, validated against in situ

PAPERS.title: Monsoon-Regulated Aerosol Variability and Radiative Effects over a Rural Receptor Site in Southeast India
PAPERS.pm: MICROTOPS-II sunphotometer AOD500 and Angstrom exponent
PAPERS.n: April 2021-December 2023 rural receptor site; annual mean AOD500 0.56 +/- 0.22, pre-monsoon 0.66, monsoon 0.49; AE 1.30 +/- 0.24 in winter/pre-monsoon vs 0.83 +/- 0.37 in monsoon; PSCF/CWT source attribution, OPAC-SBDART forcing

PAPERS.title: Multivariable Determinants of Indoor PM2.5 and Infiltration Factors in 48 Residential Buildings Across Eight Northern Chinese Cities: A Seasonal Monitoring and Linear Mixed-Effects Modelling Study
PAPERS.pm: Paired indoor/outdoor PM2.5 at 5 min, hourly aggregate
PAPERS.n: 48 residences, 8 cities, 4 seasons, 7 consecutive days each; 31,094 valid hourly observations of 32,256 scheduled. LMM with residence random intercept and AR(1) residuals, marginal R2 0.71 / conditional 0.91, ICC 0.34

PAPERS.title: Meteorological drivers of ambient PM2.5 pollution at urban traffic intersections in Accra, Ghana
PAPERS.pm: Aeroqual Ranger portable dust monitor, 9 traffic hotspots
PAPERS.n: Nine intersections across harmattan and non-harmattan seasons; median PM2.5 54.90 ug m-3 high-density, 34.26 commercial, 16.75 low-density, against the WHO 24 h guideline of 15; temperature r = 0.353 (p<0.01), wind speed r = 0.079 in harmattan

PAPERS.title: Chlorine enhances nocturnal heterogeneous uptake of NO2 in coastal atmosphere under sea-land breeze circulation
PAPERS.pm: Nocturnal particulate nitrate and HONO under sea-land breeze
PAPERS.n: Coastal Xiamen field observations plus machine learning plus a multiphase box model; mean NO2 uptake rate constant 9.70e-6 s-1 on sea-land-breeze nights. Uptake dominates HONO formation (83.9%) and contributes 46.4% of nitrate production

PAPERS.title: Long-term changes in Aitken-mode particle number concentration in Brisbane: roles of meteorology, traffic, and biomass burning
PAPERS.n: Metadata only - no abstract retrievable on the entry date. Title commits to a long-term Aitken-mode number-concentration trend attributed across meteorology, traffic and biomass burning; the trend magnitude and record length are not recoverable yet

PAPERS.title: Multi-parameter characterization of indoor air quality in a medical marijuana cultivation facility in Oklahoma: a pilot study of occupational exposure determinants
PAPERS.pm: Size-resolved PM by TSI AirAssure + 2 PurpleAir PA-II-FLEX
PAPERS.n: 186 m2 HVAC-equipped cultivation room, ~900 plants, 10 Jul-1 Aug 2023; 7 instruments (3 Aranet4 NDIR, 2 TSI AirAssure, 2 PurpleAir) across 3 zones at 1.5 m breathing height, ~113,000 QC'd records. CO2 means 979-1,086 ppm, maxima >2,200; median PM2.5 1.4-3.1 ug m-3

PAPERS.title: Occupant-driven ventilation and indoor exposure dynamics in naturally ventilated Ethiopian university dormitories
PAPERS.pm: Indoor exposure under occupant-driven natural ventilation
PAPERS.n: Metadata only - no abstract retrievable on the entry date. Naturally ventilated dormitories in Ethiopia; occupant-driven ventilation is the dominant uncontrolled term in indoor exposure models for low-resource settings, and field data are scarce

PAPERS.title: Association between air pollution, multimorbidity and polypharmacy: a systematic review and meta-analysis
PAPERS.pm: Long-term ambient PM2.5/PM10/PM1/NO2, per 5 ug m-3
PAPERS.n: 22 studies screened in, 21 meta-analysed, PROSPERO CRD42024613048; only 4/3/2/4 studies survived the per-5 ug m-3 harmonisation for PM2.5/PM10/PM1/NO2. Zero eligible studies on polypharmacy, household air pollution, older adults, or the Americas and Oceania

PAPERS.title: Short-Term Effect of Air Pollutants on Sudden Unexpected Death in Infancy: A Case-Crossover Study Based on the French National Registry
PAPERS.pm: Modelled residential daily PM10, PM2.5, NO2, O3
PAPERS.n: 1,078 SUDI cases, French national registry 2015-2022; conditional logistic regression adjusted for holidays, influenza-like illness and daily mean temperature, lags to 6 days; PM associated at lags 3-5 and over the last week of life, strongest cumulatively

PAPERS.title: Long-Term Trends and Nonlinear Interactions of PM2.5-O3 Compound Pollution in a Typical Oilfield City of the 2+26 Region
PAPERS.pm: Regulatory PM2.5 and MDA8 O3, Puyang, 2015-2025
PAPERS.n: PREPRINT. PM2.5 fell 79.6 -> 39.3 ug m-3 while MDA8 O3 rose 123.0 -> 189.6 ug m-3 over 2015-2025; weak positive PM2.5-O3 correlation only above 160 ug m-3 O3 and below 35 PM2.5 (r 0.21-0.38 by season); OPE consistently >7, indicating NOx-limited O3

PAPERS.title: Constructing Community- and Outcome-specific Weather and Air Health Risk Indices Using Explainable Machine Learning: A Multicentre Study in 66 Australian Communities
PAPERS.pm: Community- and outcome-specific air health risk index
PAPERS.n: Metadata only - no abstract retrievable on the entry date. 66 Australian communities, explainable ML to build community- and outcome-specific weather-and-air health risk indices; the pollutant set and index skill are not recoverable yet
